description: courtscheduler.crown.search.and.book — CROWN search-and-book, single OR multi-day. Multi-day when durationInMinutes > 360 OR endDate is after hearingDate. courtScheduleId is an OPTIONAL anchor.

ouCode.description: SPRDT-1283: centre ouCode so the single-day fallback can auto-create a session at a centre with no session to copy metadata from

courtCentreName.description: SPRDT-1283: centre display name for the auto-created session

courtRoomName.description: SPRDT-1283: room display name for the auto-created session

failOnNoAvailability.description: SPRDT-1572: when true, a multi-day MOVE / fresh-book that finds no consecutive run returns 422 NO_AVAILABILITY instead of an empty sessions list
